en: These votes are simulated. They are not real residents' views and not Council data. A fixed random seed ({0}) generates {1} simulated respondents, so the set is the same every time: 44 local residents, 28 commuters, 16 business owners or workers and 8 visitors, with different age-band mixes per role. Each one ticks situations by the leanings below: a 50% chance for a leaning item, 12% for the rest. Each then does 8 pick-one-of-two rounds, choosing by their role's weights for each use, with 12% "about the same" and 8% skipped. Visitors are only 8, below the 10-person threshold on purpose, to show the privacy rule. The brief allows clearly labelled simulated data
zh: 这里的票是模拟的，不是真实居民的意见，也不是 Council 的数据。我们用固定的随机种子（{0}）生成 {1} 位模拟受访者，所以每次打开结果都一样。身份分布是：附近居民 44、通勤者 28、商户 / 员工 16、访客 8，各身份的年龄段比例不同。每人按下面的倾向勾选情况：倾向项被勾的概率是 50%，其他是 12%。然后做 8 轮二选一，按各身份对用途的权重抽选，12% 选“差不多”，8% 跳过。访客只有 8 人，故意低于 10 人的门槛，用来演示隐私规则。赛题允许使用标明的模拟数据

en: Draft CBD South Parramatta Precinct Master Plan, Phase 1
zh: Draft CBD South Parramatta Precinct Master Plan（第一期）
Participate Parramatta 项目页（2026-11-15 访问）

en: A new 1,200 m² urban plaza on Council-owned land, fronting Wentworth Street.
zh: 在 Council 自有土地上新建一个 1,200 m² 的城市广场，临 Wentworth Street。

en: A flexible paved square with shade trees, public art and lighting, with outdoor dining at its edges.
zh: 有遮荫树、公共艺术和照明的灵活硬地广场，边缘是户外餐饮。

en: Can host night markets and cultural events; raised planters with built-in seating.
zh: 可以办夜市和文化活动；设抬高的种植池和一体化座椅。

en: The design puts universal access and clear walking routes first.
zh: 设计优先考虑无障碍和清晰的步行动线。

en: Council stays as anchor tenant in the new building, with a chance to add cultural infrastructure for the square.
zh: Council 留作新楼的主要租户，有机会为广场设文化基础设施。

en: In 2025 Council tested a large park and a small convention centre, then recommended a dining and nightlife precinct with a civic square.
zh: 2025 年测试过大公园和小型会展中心，最后推荐餐饮夜生活片区加市民广场。

en: A 3,500 m² open-space scheme was dropped for low yield, amenity and visual security.
zh: 3,500 m² 大开放空间方案被淘汰：开发量、舒适度和安全感都不够。

en: Two plaza locations inside the block were rejected: cut off from streets, very little sun.
zh: 把广场放在地块内部的两个位置被否决：远离街道、日照很少。

en: The size differs: the exhibition page says 1,300 m², the plan says 1,200 m².
zh: 面积说法不一：公示页面写 1,300 m²，总规正文写 1,200 m²。

en: Funding is not settled: Council budget, developer contributions, grants or joint ventures.
zh: 建设资金还没定，可能来自 Council 预算、开发贡献、政府拨款或合资。

en: The name is provisional and will go through a formal naming process.
zh: 名字是暂定的，要走正式命名程序。

en: The plan gives no area for each use. That is what this tool asks you to try.
zh: 总规没有给出各项功能各占多少面积——这正是本工具请你来试的部分。

en: The plan's site map numbers 21 changes: 13 is Woodhouse Square, and 21 is the redeveloped public car park with mixed-use buildings. The same map and legend are on p.26.
zh: 总规的场地平面图给 21 项改造编了号：13 号是 Woodhouse Square，21 号是重建的公共停车场和混合用途建筑。同一张图和图例也在 p.26。

en: Restaurants on Church St; hawker-style food, art and lighting in laneways and arcades; night markets and outdoor dining.
zh: Church Street 的餐饮零售，小巷和拱廊里的大排档式美食、艺术和灯光，配夜市和户外餐饮。

en: $1 million in the draft 2026/27 budget for Church St upgrades: fences out, trees, paving, Chinatown signage and lanterns.
zh: 2026/27 预算草案给 Church Street 升级拨了 100 万澳元：拆围栏、种树、铺装、唐人街标识和灯笼。

en: Arcades hold fine-grain restaurants and cafes, no wider than 4 m each.
zh: 拱廊里是小开间餐饮，店面宽度不超过 4 米。

en: Council endorsed a trial Special Entertainment Precinct covering this area, to encourage night-time activity.
zh: Council 已通过包括本片区的 Special Entertainment Precinct（特别娱乐区）试点，鼓励夜间活动。

en: The name is “Chinatown Precinct”, not “Asian Food and Nightlife Precinct”.
zh: 名称定为 “Chinatown Precinct”，不用 “Asian Food and Nightlife Precinct”。

en: Public art, lighting and signage wait for a Public Art Master Plan.
zh: 公共艺术、照明和标识要等之后的公共艺术总体规划。

en: Council will work with local Chinese community groups, businesses and residents on the Chinatown precinct.
zh: 要和本地华人社团、商家和居民沟通，共同确定唐人街的做法。

en: Fitzwilliam St and Wentworth St become one-way; Woodhouse Lane and the roundabout are removed.
zh: Fitzwilliam St 和 Wentworth St 改为单向通行，拆除 Woodhouse Lane 和环岛。

en: A new raised pedestrian crossing lines up with Rivoli Way.
zh: 在对着 Rivoli Way 的位置新增抬高的人行横道。

en: A new public car park on Council land replaces the station car park: underground plus sleeved above-ground parking.
zh: 在 Council 用地上新建公共停车场，替换现有车站停车场：地下加包裹式地上停车。

en: Separated cycleways go on Fitzwilliam St and Valentine Ave, not through the square.
zh: 分隔式骑行道建在 Fitzwilliam St 和 Valentine Ave，不经过广场。

en: Kiss-and-ride and taxi drop-off move to Fitzwilliam St.
zh: 即停即走和出租车下客区集中在 Fitzwilliam St。

en: No traffic modelling yet: scope and budget go to Council first, with consultants in FY27/28.
zh: 交通模型还没做：研究范围和预算要先报批，FY27/28 才聘顾问。

en: The station and Argyle St bus interchange wait for the Phase 2 master plan.
zh: 车站和 Argyle St 公交换乘站留到第二期总规再看。

en: The car park still needs feasibility work; no source says whether it sits under the square.
zh: 停车场还要做可行性研究；它是否在广场正下方，来源里没有说。

en: This is a new public space near home. The plan says what it should have, but not how much of each.
zh: 这是你家附近新的公共空间：总规写了要有什么，但没写各占多少。

en: Outdoor dining lines its edges and it can host night markets, which matters for Church St trade.
zh: 广场边缘是户外餐饮，可以办夜市——和 Church St 的生意直接相关。

en: The square sits on the walk between the station and Jubilee Park, with a new crossing at Rivoli Way.
zh: 广场在车站和 Jubilee Park 之间的步行线上，新的横道对着 Rivoli Way。

en: This is the new heart of Chinatown: events, night markets and gatherings.
zh: 这是唐人街的新中心：活动、夜市和聚会都在这里。

en: Expect more night-time activity; Council is trialling a Special Entertainment Precinct.
zh: 夜间活动会更多，Council 已在试点特别娱乐区。

en: Church St has a $1m upgrade budget, and arcades become small food tenancies.
zh: Church St 已有 100 万澳元的升级预算，拱廊会改成小开间餐饮。

en: Church St loses its fences and gains trees, so it will be easier to walk.
zh: Church St 会拆围栏、种树，走起来更舒服。

en: Hawker food, night markets, lanterns and public art set the place apart.
zh: 大排档、夜市、灯笼和公共艺术是这里的特色。

en: Streets go one-way with wider footpaths, but there is no official traffic model yet.
zh: 街道改单向，人行道更宽；但交通影响还没有官方模型。

en: Loading, parking and drop-off move; car park access shifts to Wentworth St and Parkes St.
zh: 送货、停车和接送的位置会变，停车场入口改在 Wentworth St 和 Parkes St。

en: Drop-off moves to Fitzwilliam St; cycleways run on Fitzwilliam St and Valentine Ave.
zh: 接送区集中到 Fitzwilliam St，骑行道在 Fitzwilliam St 和 Valentine Ave。

en: Walking from the station to Chinatown and the square becomes more direct and safer.
zh: 从车站走到唐人街和广场会更直接、更安全。
蓝绿基础设施（雨水花园）

zh: 方案 0：总规原样（我们的解读）

en: Area in shade on a summer afternoon. Tree crowns grow with age.
zh: 夏季午后有树荫或遮挡的面积。树冠随树龄长大。

en: Rain the square can hold back in one storm.
zh: 一场雨能在广场里留住的雨水量。

en: People who can attend events, markets and dining at once.
zh: 同时能容纳的活动、市集和用餐人数。

en: Share of the square kept clear for walking. Wider traffic effects await Council's traffic study [S4].
zh: 广场里留给畅通步行的比例。周边交通影响要等官方交通研究〔S4〕。

en: Proxy score: night-time activity, lighting and open sightlines.
zh: 代理指标：夜间有人活动、有照明、视线通透。

en: Proxy score: seating, play space, access and shade.
zh: 代理指标：座椅、儿童空间、无障碍和遮荫。

en: Proxy score: cultural expression, events and places to linger.
zh: 代理指标：文化表达、活动和停留空间。

en: Build cost plus maintenance up to the chosen year.
zh: 建设费加上到所选年份为止的累计维护费。
建造材料带来的碳排放。

en: Night markets, events, places to stay

zh: 假设：我们对总规的解读

en: Upgraded public domain - lighting, public art, paving
zh: 升级公共空间：照明、公共艺术、铺装

en: Woodhouse Square - new urban public space
zh: Woodhouse Square：新的城市公共空间
升级公共空间：加宽人行道

en: Redeveloped public car park, mixed-use buildings
zh: 重建公共停车场，混合用途建筑

en: Hard to find shade along Wentworth St in the afternoon
zh: 下午沿 Wentworth St 走，很难找到树荫
现在这一带的树冠覆盖率

en: Out with kids or older people, there is nowhere nearby to sit
zh: 带孩子或老人出门，附近没地方坐下歇脚

en: With a wheelchair or pram, the route keeps breaking up
zh: 坐轮椅或推婴儿车，路线断断续续

en: Worried a car park underneath means no big trees
zh: 担心广场下面是停车场，种不了大树

en: Walking from the station to Church St at night, some stretches feel dark
zh: 晚上从车站走到 Church St，有几段觉得暗

en: More night-time activity: worried about noise and litter
zh: 夜间活动多了，担心噪音和垃圾

en: Chinese community groups and long-time shops should help shape Chinatown
zh: 希望华人社团和老店能参与决定唐人街怎么做

en: Fences on Church St make crossing and browsing a detour
zh: Church St 的围栏让过街、逛店都要绕路

en: Crossing Fitzwilliam St or Wentworth St means a long wait and heavy traffic
zh: 过 Fitzwilliam St 或 Wentworth St 要等很久，车也多

en: Drop-off cars near the station block the footpath
zh: 车站附近接送的车停在路边，挡住人行道

en: Cycling to the station, there is no safe lane
zh: 骑车去车站，没有安全的车道

en: Changing between bus and train is confusing
zh: 公交和火车之间怎么换乘不清楚
